label: Team-play hooks
description: The ways a unit creates teamwork. Used on patterns and cards, and filterable in the library.

terms.label: Setup and finisher
terms.description: One player changes a target's state (stun, freeze, strip shields) so another can convert it into a kill.

terms.label: Rescue
terms.description: Teammates can undo a specific enemy effect on a victim: remove a parasite, unfreeze, revive.

terms.label: Seat synergy
terms.description: Who rides inside changes or boosts the unit.

terms.label: Carry
terms.description: Moves teammates where they need to be.

terms.label: Protector
terms.description: Shields, heals or repairs others on an ongoing basis.

terms.label: Resupply
terms.description: Refills teammates' ammo, energy, fuel or ability charges, or needs teammates to refill its own.

terms.label: Forward spawn
terms.description: Gives teammates a place to respawn or re-equip near the fight.

terms.label: Spotter
terms.description: Gives the team information: reveals or marks targets.

terms.label: Bait and trap
terms.description: Lures enemies into teammates or a trap.

terms.label: Needs an escort
terms.description: Strong, but helpless against its counter without a bodyguard.

terms.label: Counter-pick
terms.description: The enemy team must coordinate unit choices to answer it.

terms.label: Swarm
terms.description: Several players on the same unit type stack their effects.

terms.label: Share the spoils
terms.description: Gains from kills (salvage, pickups) can be handed to or earned with teammates.
